name: Slider

figmaSource.note: This component's type prop selects between three separate Figma components, not one - each recorded separately below.

behaviorRules: Inside a disabled <fieldset>, the native control is disabled without the disabled prop, and the component looks and behaves exactly as with disabled (its disabled styling also keys off :disabled, via :has() on the wrapper).
SliderRange submits the lower value under minName and the upper under maxName; they default to name and `${name}Max`.
The value bubble shows on hover, focus, and drag; showValue keeps it showing. A horizontal slider always makes room for it above the track, so it never covers the label (its own or Field's).
A disabled slider (disabled, or inside a disabled fieldset) never starts a drag: a pointer press sets no data-dragging.
SliderRange is a group named by label, aria-labelledby, or aria-label; each handle's name is that name plus minLabel or maxLabel.

invalid (or an aria-invalid of true, which Field passes for an error) sets data-invalid on the root, which swaps the handle, track, and step-dot custom properties to the error colors, and sets aria-invalid on the handle (both handles on SliderRange). Disabled colors win.

Field wires Slider like its other controls: its id, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, and required reach the input. On SliderRange, id is the lower handle's id (the other ids start with it: <id>-max, <id>-range), aria-labelledby names the group, and aria-describedby, aria-invalid, and required go to both handles, not the group. required never blocks a submit: a range always has a value.
implementationNotes: Shared FocusRing, drawn on the visible handle from the primitive's variables (the native input fills the control and has no outline)
